**Was the request framed as a suggestion, not a demand?** - *"Want to try this?"* (open-ended) vs. *"Put on Old Spice."* (directive) - **Did the person have a chance to say no or express their preference?** - If they say no, don’t push it. - If they’re unsure, offer to let them try it first. - If they love it, great! If not, no hard feelings. --- ### **Final Verdict** The original scenario leans heavily toward <0> because it lacks **consent, context, and mutual agreement**.
